text: ITEM 1 | Single wedge-shaped slice on the upper right edge of a white square plate, roughly 6 cm by 9 cm footprint, covering about 5% of the plate; crust edge is pale golden-tan with light browning, cheese surface is pale yellow-white with some melted spots, one large round reddish-orange slice of cured meat (about 4 cm across) sits near the center with glossy, slightly oily sheen, and small dark-brown crumbled bits are scattered on the top-left portion; the slice is thin, about 1 cm thick at the crust, and holds its shape firmly | 45
